look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a pile of map() glue, an API-to-dropdown reshape, raw objects slotting into a Rokkit list, a selected original object, and the Rokkit end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.desc: A pile of map() calls: the glue before anything renders.
scenes.name: The glue pile

scenes.desc: API gives users, the dropdown wants label and value, so you map.
scenes.name: Reshape for the widget

scenes.desc: Raw objects slot straight into a Rokkit list, no map().
scenes.name: Data flows in as-is

scenes.desc: Selection hands back the original object, not a copy.
scenes.name: Your object back

scenes.desc: End card with the Rokkit mark: stop reshaping data for your UI.
scenes.name: Rokkit

title: Stop reshaping data for your UI
